tools.description: Observe one replay session: its mode, status, checkpoints, and a summary of every step, including each effect's kind and whether its outcome succeeded.
tools.name: observe

tools.description: Fork a new worker from a declared worker definition into isolated world custody and run it to its terminal record. Returns the worker session and custody identities.
tools.name: fork

tools.description: Discard a forked worker's world custody. The custody and every change in it are removed.
tools.name: discard

tools.description: Rewind a replay session to a retained checkpoint or step boundary: its worlds are restored into fresh roots and its prefix is copied without re-running anything.
tools.name: rewind

tools.description: Replay a replay session from a retained checkpoint or step boundary under a declared worker variant: the prefix is served from the record and the suffix runs live with the variant's changes.
tools.name: replay

tools.description: Read retained records of one trace owner path in ordinal order, starting at an ordinal, bounded by a record count.
tools.name: read_trace

tools.description: Align a rewind or replay branch with its source session step by step and report the first divergence, the common prefix, and every divergence the declared changes do not explain.
tools.name: diff
